data.action: 坐于贡多拉丝绒船座俯身指尖轻触水面，温柔浅笑
data.animaCaption: Seated on the velvet cushions of a gliding gondola at night, she dips her fingertips into the canal water as warm lantern reflections shimmer across the ripples.
data.camera: 全身镜头，水面低视角倒影构图
data.description: 静谧的拉古那月夜运河上，华丽的黑金贡多拉缓缓滑过石桥，珂莱塔披着珍珠流苏酒红羊绒披肩坐在丝绒船座上，指尖轻触水面波光。
data.lighting: 船头提灯暖黄倒影与水波银色月光
data.location: 拉古那月夜运河贡多拉
data.promptProse: Gliding beneath an arched stone bridge along Ragunna's moonlit canal, Carlotta sits in a velvet-cushioned gondola wrapped in a pearl-fringed shawl, trailing her fingers through the lantern-lit water.
data.title: 珂莱塔 · 拉古那夜航贡多拉船头水灯
